title: Advisor Practice with More Than $270 Million in Assets Joins Ameriprise Financial for Technology, Growth and Succession Planning Support
summary: Johnson Stivender Wealth Advisors join the independent channel of Ameriprise from Raymond James Financial Services Private wealth advisory practice Johnson Stivender Wealth Advisors recently joined the independent channel of Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) from Raymond James Financial Services, Inc. in Sebring, Fla., with more than $270 million in client assets. The practice is led by private wealth advisors Dusty Johnson CFP®, APMA® , Craig Johnson and Travis Stivender , and includes operations manager Michele Bednosky and client relationship specialist Kristin Johnson . After more than 25 years with their previous firm, Johnson Stivender Wealth Advisors was looking for a firm that would be a strategic partner to help them build and execute an achievable succession plan while preserving the high-touch service model their clients have come to expect.
